3:2: Allah, there is no deity except Him, al-Hayy, al-Qayyum.
3:3: He sent down the Book to you with truth, confirming what came before it, and He also sent down the Torah and the Gospel.
3:4: Before, as guidance for the people. And He sent down the Furqan. Surely, for those who disbelieve in the verses of Allah, there is a severe punishment, and Allah is Almighty, Possessor of retribution.
3:5: Surely, nothing in the earth and in the heaven is hidden from Allah.
3:6: It is He who shapes you in the wombs as He wills. There is no deity except Him. He is the Mighty, Possessor of judgment and wisdom.
3:7: He is the One Who sent down the Book to you. From it are muhkam verses which are the mother of the Book, and others are mutashabih. Those in whose hearts is deviation follow what is mutashabih of it, seeking discord and seeking its interpretation. Yet none knows its interpretation except Allah. And those deeply rooted in knowledge say: 'We believed in it, all is from our Rabb.' And none ponders this except people of understanding.
3:8: Our Rabb, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Your presence; surely You are the Bestower.
3:9: Our Rabb, surely You are the Gatherer of mankind on a Day about which there is no doubt. Surely Allah does not fail in His promise.
3:10: Surely, those who disbelieve, neither their wealth nor their children will ever avail them anything against Allah, and they are the fuel of the Fire.
3:11: Like the custom of the family of Pharaoh and those before them; they denied Our verses, so Allah seized them because of their sins, and Allah is severe in punishment.
3:12: Say to those who disbelieve: You will soon be defeated and gathered to Hell, and what an evil resting place it is.
3:13: Truly, there was a sign for you in the two groups that met. One group was fighting in the cause of Allah, and the other was disbelieving; they saw them with their eyes as twice their number, and Allah supports with His help whom He wills. Surely in this is a lesson for those who see.
3:14: Beautified for people is the love of desires: from women, sons, heaped-up heaps of gold and silver, branded horses, livestock, and crops. That is the provision of the worldly life. As for Allah, with Him is the excellent return.
3:15: Say: Shall I inform you of something better than this? For those who have taqwa, with their Rabb are gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever, and purified spouses, and good pleasure from Allah, and Allah is Seeing of His servants.
3:16: Those who say: Our Rabb, surely we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
3:17: They are the patient, the truthful, the devoutly obedient, those who spend, and those who seek forgiveness before dawn.
3:18: Allah bore witness that there is no deity except Him. And the angels and those of knowledge, standing with justice, also bore witness that there is no deity except Him, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
3:19: Surely the religion with Allah is Islam. Those who were given the Book did not fall into disagreement except after knowledge came to them, out of insolence among themselves. And whoever disbelieves in the verses of Allah, then surely Allah is swift in reckoning.
3:20: So if they dispute with you, say: I have submitted my face to Allah, and so have those who follow me. And say to those who were given the Book and to the unlettered: Have you also submitted? If they have submitted, they have surely found the right way. But if they turn away, then your duty is only conveyance. And Allah is fully Seeing of the servants.
3:21: Surely those who disbelieve in the verses of Allah, kill the prophets unjustly, and kill those among people who command justice—give them glad tidings of a painful punishment.
3:22: Those are the ones whose deeds have come to nothing in this world and the Hereafter, and they have no helpers.
3:23: Have you not seen those who were given a share of the Book? They are invited to the Book of Allah so that it may judge between them, then a group of them turns away, and they are averse.
3:24: That is because they say, 'The Fire will never touch us except for a numbered days,' and what they invented in their religion deluded them.
3:25: Then how will it be when We gather them on a Day about which there is no doubt? Every soul will be paid in full for what it earned, and they will not be wronged.
3:26: Say: O Allah, Owner of the kingdom! You give the kingdom to whom You will, You take away the kingdom from whom You will. You honor whom You will, You abase whom You will.
3:27: You cause the night to enter into the day, and You cause the day to enter into the night. You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. You provide without measure for whom You will.
3:28: Let not the believers take the disbelievers as allies instead of the believers; whoever does that is in nothing from Allah, except that you take precaution against them; and Allah warns you of Himself, and to Allah is the return.
3:29: Say: 'Whether you conceal what is in your breasts or reveal it, Allah knows it.' He knows what is in the heavens and what is in the earth. Allah has power over all things.
3:30: That Day every soul will find present the good it has done, and as for the evil it has done, it will wish that there were a great distance between itself and it. And Allah warns you of Himself. Allah is full of compassion toward the servants.
3:31: Say: 'If you love Allah, follow me so that Allah will love you and forgive your sins.' Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
3:32: Say: Obey Allah and the Messenger. But if they turn away, surely Allah does not love the disbelievers.
3:33: Surely Allah chose Adam, Noah, the family of Abraham, and the family of Imran above the worlds.
3:34: As offspring, one from the other. Allah is Hearing, Knowing.
3:35: When the wife of Imran said: 'My Rabb! I have vowed to You what is in my womb as freed. Accept it from me. Surely You are the Hearing, the Knowing.'
3:36: When she gave birth to her, she said: 'My Rabb! I have given birth to a female.' Allah knows better what she gave birth to. And the male is not like the female. 'And I have named her Mary, and I seek refuge with You for her and her offspring from the outcast Satan.'
3:37: So her Rabb accepted her with a good acceptance and caused her to grow like a good plant. And He put Zechariah in charge of her care. Whenever Zechariah entered the sanctuary upon her, he found provision with her. He said: 'O Mary! From where did this come to you?' She said: 'It is from Allah.' Surely Allah provides for whom He wills without measure.
3:38: There Zechariah prayed to his Rabb. He said: 'My Rabb! Grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Surely You are the Hearer of prayer.'
3:39: While he stood praying in the sanctuary, the angels called out to him: 'Surely Allah gives you the good news of John; confirming a word from Allah, an honorable master, self-controlled, and a prophet from among the righteous.'
3:40: He said: 'My Rabb, how can I have a son when old age has already reached me and my wife is barren?' He said: 'Thus it is; Allah does whatever He wills.'
3:41: He said: 'My Rabb, appoint for me a sign.' He said: 'Your sign is that you will not speak to people for three days except by gestures. And remember your Rabb much and glorify Him evening and morning.'
3:42: At that time the angels said: 'O Mary, surely Allah has chosen you, purified you, and chosen you above the women of the worlds.'
3:43: O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Rabb, prostrate, and bow down with those who bow down.
3:44: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you. And you were not with them when they cast their pens as to which of them should take charge of Mary, nor were you with them when they disputed.
3:45: At that time the angels said: 'O Mary, surely Allah gives you the good news of a word from Him. His name is the Messiah Jesus, son of Mary. He is honored in this world and the Hereafter, and is of those brought near.'
3:46: He will speak to people in the cradle and in maturity, and he is of the righteous.
3:47: She said: 'My Rabb, how can I have a child when no human has touched me?' He said: 'Even so, Allah creates whatever He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be!' and it immediately is.'
3:48: And He teaches him the Book, wisdom, the Torah, and the Gospel.
3:49: And as a messenger to the Children of Israel: 'I have come to you with a sign from your Rabb. I create for you out of clay something in the shape of a bird, then I breathe into it, and it becomes a bird by Allah's permission. I heal the born blind and the leper, and I give life to the dead by Allah's permission. And I inform you of what you eat and what you store up in your houses. Surely in this there is a sign for you, if you are believers.'
3:50: And I have come confirming what was before me of the Torah and to make lawful for you some of that which was forbidden to you, and I have come to you with a sign from your Rabb; so fear Allah and obey me.
3:51: Surely Allah is my Rabb and your Rabb, so worship Him; this is a straight path.
3:52: When Jesus perceived disbelief from them, he said: 'Who are my helpers on the way to Allah?' The disciples said: 'We are Allah's helpers. We have believed in Allah, and bear witness that we are Muslims.'
3:53: Our Rabb, we have believed in what You revealed and followed the messenger, so write us down among the witnesses.
3:54: And they plotted, and Allah plotted, and Allah is the best of plotters.
3:55: At that time Allah said: 'O Jesus, surely I will cause you to die and raise you to Myself, and I will purify you from those who disbelieve, and I will place those who follow you above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return; I will judge between you concerning the matters over which you used to differ.'
3:56: As for those who disbelieve, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers.
3:57: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, He will pay them their rewards in full; and Allah does not love the wrongdoers.
3:58: This is what We recite to you of the verses and the wise Reminder.
3:59: Surely the likeness of Jesus in the sight of Allah is as the likeness of Adam. He created him from dust, then said to him, 'Be!' and he was.
3:60: The truth is from your Rabb, so do not be among the doubters.
3:61: So whoever disputes with you concerning it after knowledge has come to you, say: 'Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then let us invoke a curse upon one another and place the curse of Allah upon the liars.'
3:62: Surely this is the true narrative, and there is no deity except Allah; and surely Allah, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
3:63: If they turn away, then surely Allah is All-Knowing of the corrupters.
3:64: Say: 'O People of the Book! Come to an equitable word between us and you: that we worship none but Allah, associate nothing as partner with Him, and that none of us take others as rabbs besides Allah.' If they turn away, then say: 'Bear witness that we are Muslims.'
3:65: O People of the Book! Why do you dispute concerning Abraham? The Torah and the Gospel were only revealed after him. Will you not reason?
3:66: Here you are! You disputed about that of which you had knowledge. Why then do you dispute about that of which you have no knowledge? Allah knows, and you do not know.
3:67: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian; but he was a hanif Muslim, and he was not of the polytheists.
3:68: Surely the closest of people to Abraham are those who followed him, and this Prophet, and those who believe. Allah is the wali of the believers.
3:69: A party of the People of the Book wished to lead you astray. Yet they lead none astray but themselves, and they do not realize it.
3:70: O People of the Book! Why do you deny the verses of Allah while you bear witness?
3:71: O People of the Book! Why do you mix truth with falsehood and conceal the truth while you know?
3:72: A party of the People of the Book said: 'Believe in what was revealed to those who believe at the beginning of the day, and disbelieve at the end of it, so that perhaps they may turn back.'
3:73: And do not believe except in one who follows your religion. Say: 'Surely guidance is Allah's guidance.' Is it because someone else has been given the like of what you were given, or because they will dispute with you before your Rabb?' Say: 'Surely bounty is in the hand of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills.' And Allah is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing.
3:74: He singles out for His mercy whom He wills. Allah is the Possessor of great bounty.
3:75: Among the People of the Book there is he who, if you entrust him with a qintar, will return it to you; and among them is he who, if you entrust him with a dinar, will not return it to you unless you keep standing over him. This is because they say: 'There is no blame upon us concerning the unlettered (those without a scripture).' And they tell lies against Allah knowingly.
3:76: Yes, whoever fulfills his covenant and guards against evil, then surely Allah loves the people of taqwa.
3:77: Surely those who sell Allah's covenant and their oaths for a small price, they will have no share in the Hereafter. Allah will not speak to them, nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor purify them. And for them is a painful punishment.
3:78: Surely there is a group among them who distort their tongues with the Book so that you may think it is from the Book, while it is not from the Book. And they say, 'It is from Allah,' while it is not from Allah. And they tell lies against Allah knowingly.
3:79: It is not fitting for any human that, after Allah has given him the Book, judgment, and prophethood, he should say to the people, 'Be servants to me instead of Allah.' Rather, he says, 'Be servants of the Rabb by virtue of the Book you teach and the things you study.'
3:80: And he does not command you to take the angels and the prophets as rabbs. Would he command you to kufr after you have become Muslims?
3:81: And when Allah took a covenant from the prophets: 'Whatever I have given you of the Book and wisdom, then when a messenger comes to you confirming what is with you, you will surely believe in him and you will help him.' He said: 'Have you affirmed and taken upon yourselves this heavy burden of Mine?' They said: 'We have affirmed.' He said: 'Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses.'
3:82: Whoever turns away after this, then those are the very ones who are fasiks.
3:83: Or do they seek other than the religion of Allah? Whereas everyone in the heavens and on the earth submits to Him willingly or unwillingly, and to Him they will be returned.
3:84: Say: 'We have believed in Allah, in what has been sent down to us, in what was sent down to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the descendants, and in what was given to Moses, Jesus, and the prophets from their Rabb; we do not differentiate between any of them, and we are submitted to Him.'
3:85: Whoever seeks a religion other than Islam, it will never be accepted from him, and in the Hereafter he will be among the losers.
3:86: How does Allah guide a people who disbelieved after their belief, while they had witnessed that the messenger is true and clear proofs had come to them? And Allah does not guide the community of the wrongdoers.
3:87: As for those, their penalty is that upon them is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people.
3:88: They will abide therein eternally; the punishment will not be lightened from them, nor will they be delayed.
3:89: Except those who repent after this and make amends. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
3:90: Indeed, those who disbelieve after having believed, then increase in their kufr, their repentance will never be accepted. Those are the very ones who are astray.
3:91: Indeed, those who disbelieve and die as kafirs, from none of them would even the earth full of gold be accepted, even if he were to offer it as ransom. For those there is a painful punishment, and for them there are no helpers.
3:92: You will never reach goodness unless you give infaq from the things you love. And whatever you give as infaq, surely Allah is Knower of it.
3:93: All food was halal for the Children of Israel, except what Israel made haram for himself before the Torah was sent down. Say: 'Then bring the Torah and read it, if you are truthful.'
3:94: So whoever invents a lie against Allah after this, then those are the very wrongdoers.
3:95: Say: "Allah has spoken the truth." So follow the hanif religion of Abraham; he was not of the mushriks.
3:96: Surely the first house established for mankind is the house in Mecca, blessed and a guidance for the worlds.
3:97: In it are clear signs, the station of Abraham. Whoever enters it is secure. And performing Hajj to the Bayt is a right of Allah upon the people who are able to find a way to it. And whoever commits kufr, surely Allah is free of need of the worlds.
3:98: Say: "O People of the Book! Why do you deny the verses of Allah, while Allah is witness to what you do?"
3:99: Say: O People of the Book! Why do you hinder those who believe from the way of Allah, wishing to make it crooked, while you are witnesses? And Allah is not unaware of what you do.
3:100: O you who believe! If you obey a group from those who were given the Book, they will turn you back as kafirs after your belief.
3:101: And how do you deny while Allah's verses are being recited to you and His messenger is among you? Whoever holds fast to Allah, he has indeed been guided to a straight path.
3:102: O you who believe, be mindful of Allah as He should be feared, and die only as Muslims.
3:103: Hold fast all together to the rope of Allah and do not fall into division. Remember Allah's favor upon you: when you were enemies, then He joined your hearts, and by His favor you became brothers. And you were on the edge of a pit of fire, and He saved you from it. Thus Allah makes His verses clear to you, so that you may find the right path.
3:104: Let there be an ummah from you that calls to the good, enjoins al-maruf, and forbids al-munkar. Those are the ones who attain salvation.
3:105: Do not be like those who fell into division and differed after clear proofs came to them. For those there is a great punishment.
3:106: On that Day, faces will turn white and faces will turn black. As for those whose faces have turned black: Did you commit kufr after your belief? Then taste the punishment because of what you used to disbelieve.
3:107: As for those whose faces turn white, they are in Allah's mercy; they will abide therein eternally.
3:108: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth, and Allah does not desire injustice for the worlds.
3:109: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth belongs to Allah, and all matters are returned to Allah.
3:110: You are the best ummah brought forth for mankind; you enjoin good, forbid evil, and believe in Allah. And if the People of the Book had believed, it would have been better for them. Among them are believers, but most of them are fasiks.
3:111: They will never harm you, except for an annoyance; and if they fight with you, they will turn their backs to you, then they will not be helped.
3:112: Humiliation has been struck upon them wherever they are found, except (if they hold onto) a rope from Allah and a rope from the people. They incurred wrath from Allah and destitution was struck upon them. This is because they used to deny the verses of Allah and kill the prophets unjustly. This is because they rebelled and exceeded the limits.
3:113: They are not equal. From the People of the Book there is a community that recites the verses of Allah during the hours of the night, prostrating.
3:114: They believe in Allah and the Last Day, enjoin good, forbid evil, and race in good deeds. And those are of the righteous.
3:115: Whatever good they do will never be denied, and Allah is Knower of the people of taqwa.
3:116: Indeed, the wealth and children of those who disbelieve will not benefit them at all against Allah, and those are the companions of the Fire.
3:117: The example of what they spend in this worldly life is like the example of a wind containing freezing cold; it strikes the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves and destroys it. Allah did not wrong them, but they wrong themselves.
3:118: O you who believe, do not take confidants from other than yourselves; they do not hold back from causing you ruin, they desire your falling into hardship. Their hatred has become apparent from their mouths, and what their hearts conceal is even greater. We have made the verses clear to you, if you reason.
3:119: Here you are, you love them, whereas they do not love you, and you believe in all of the Book. When they meet you, they say "we have believed", but when they are alone, they bite their fingertips at you in rage. Say: die in your rage. Undoubtedly Allah is the Knower of what is inside the breasts.
3:120: If a good touches you, it grieves them; if an evil befalls you, they rejoice at it. If you are patient and guard yourselves, their plot will not harm you at all.
3:121: When you had left early in the morning from your family, positioning the believers in their battle posts, and Allah is Hearing, Knowing.
3:122: At that time two groups from among you attempted to lose heart, whereas Allah was their guardian, and let the believers place their trust only in Allah.
3:123: And by oath, Allah had helped you at Badr while you were in a weak state; so guard yourselves against Allah, so that you may give thanks.
3:124: At that time you were saying to the believers: Is it not enough for you that your Rabb helps you with three thousand angels sent down?
3:125: Yes, if you are patient and guard yourselves, and they come upon you suddenly, your Rabb will help you with five thousand marked angels.
3:126: Allah made this only as a good news for you and so that your hearts may be satisfied with it. Help is only from the presence of Allah, who is al-Aziz and al-Hakim.
3:127: It is so that He may cut off a part of those who disbelieve or humiliate them so that they turn back in despair.
3:128: Nothing of the matter falls to you; either He accepts their repentance or He punishes them. Undoubtedly they are wrongdoers.
3:129: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth belongs to Allah. He forgives whom He wills, and punishes whom He wills. Allah is very forgiving, very merciful.
3:130: O you who believe, do not consume interest multiplied folds upon folds, and guard yourselves against Allah so that you may attain salvation.
3:131: Guard yourselves against the Fire which has been prepared for the disbelievers.
3:132: Obey Allah and the Messenger so that you may be shown mercy.
3:133: Hasten to a forgiveness from your Rabb and to a Paradise whose width is the heavens and the earth, prepared for the possessors of taqwa.
3:134: They are those who spend in ease and hardship, who restrain their anger, and who forgive people. Allah loves the doers of good.
3:135: And they are those who, when they commit an immoral deed or wrong themselves, remember Allah and ask forgiveness for their sins. And who forgives sins other than Allah? And they do not persist in what they have done, and they know.
3:136: Those, their reward is a forgiveness from their Rabb and gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, and how excellent is the reward of the workers.
3:137: Truly, many ways have passed before you. Walk upon the earth and see how the end of the deniers was.
3:138: This is an explanation for the people, a guidance and an admonition for the possessors of taqwa.
3:139: Do not lose heart and do not grieve; if you are believers, you are the ones who are superior.
3:140: If a wound has touched you, a similar wound had also touched that community. And We alternate those days among the people, so that Allah may know those who believe and may take witnesses from among you. Allah does not love the wrongdoers.
3:141: And so that Allah may purify those who believe and destroy the disbelievers.
3:142: Or did you think that you would enter Paradise without Allah knowing those of you who strive and those who are patient?
3:143: By oath, you were wishing for death before meeting it. Now you have seen it, and you are looking.
3:144: And Muhammad is only a messenger; messengers have passed away before him. So if he dies or is killed, will you turn back on your heels? Whoever turns back on his heels cannot harm Allah in anything. And Allah will reward the grateful.
3:145: No soul dies without Allah's permission; it is a predetermined writing. Whoever desires the reward of the world, We give him of it; and whoever desires the reward of the Hereafter, We give him of it. And We will reward the grateful.
3:146: There were many prophets with whom many godly people fought, and they did not lose heart due to what befell them in the way of Allah, nor did they weaken, nor did they yield.
3:147: Their word was only this: 'Our Rabb, forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affair, make our feet firm, and help us against the community of disbelievers.'
3:148: So Allah gave them the reward of the world and the beauty of the reward of the Hereafter, and Allah loves the doers of good.
3:149: O you who believe, if you obey those who disbelieve, they will turn you back on your heels, and you will become losers.
3:150: On the contrary, Allah is your protector, and He is the best of helpers.
3:151: We will cast fear into the hearts of those who disbelieve, because they associated partners with Allah for which He sent down no authority. Their destination is the Fire. How evil is the dwelling place of the wrongdoers!
3:152: By oath, Allah made His promise true to you when you were killing them by His permission, until you lost heart and disputed about the command and rebelled after He showed you what you love; some of you were desiring the world and some of you were desiring the Hereafter; then He turned you away from them so that He might test you, and by oath He pardoned you, and Allah is the Possessor of bounty to the believers.
3:153: At that time you were climbing away, not turning to look at anyone, while the Messenger was calling you from behind you; thereupon Allah gave you grief upon grief so that you would not grieve over what escaped you and what befell you, and Allah is aware of what you do.
3:154: Then after the grief, He sent down upon you a security, a slumber that envelopes a group among you. Another group, however, fell into concern for their own lives, harboring thoughts about Allah unjustly, like the assumption of jahiliyyah. They say: 'Do we have any share in this matter?' Say: 'The whole matter belongs to Allah.' They conceal within themselves what they do not disclose to you, saying: 'If we had any share in this matter, we would not have been killed here.' Say: 'Even if you had been in your houses, those upon whom death was written would still have gone out to the places where they were to be killed.' Allah (did this) to test what is in your breasts and to purify what is in your hearts. Allah knows the essence of the breasts.
3:155: Those of you who turned away on the day the two groups met, Satan only caused their feet to slip because of some things they had earned. And certainly Allah forgave them. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Forbearing.
3:156: O you who believe, do not be like those who disbelieved and said of their brothers when they traveled on the earth or were warriors: 'Had they been with us, they would not have died and would not have been killed.' So that Allah may make this a regret in their hearts. Allah gives life and causes death. Allah is the Seer of what you do.
3:157: And if you are killed in the way of Allah or die, surely forgiveness and mercy from Allah is better than what they gather.
3:158: And certainly, whether you die or are killed, unto Allah you will be gathered.
3:159: By a mercy from Allah you were gentle with them. If you had been rude, harsh-hearted, they would have dispersed from around you. So pardon them, ask forgiveness for them, and consult them in the matter. And when you have decided, then trust in Allah. Surely Allah loves those who trust in Him.
3:160: If Allah helps you, then there is none who can overcome you; and if He leaves you without help, who is it that will help you after Him?
3:161: It is not for any prophet to betray. Whoever betrays will come on the Day of Resurrection with what he betrayed. Then every soul will be paid in full what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
3:162: Is one who follows the pleasure of Allah like one who incurs wrath from Allah and whose refuge is Hell? What an evil destination it is!
3:163: They are in degrees with Allah, and Allah is the Seer of what they do.
3:164: Certainly Allah has conferred favor upon the believers by sending among them a messenger from themselves; he recites His verses to them, purifies them, and teaches them the Book and wisdom.
3:165: When a disaster struck you, though you had inflicted twice as much, you said: 'From where is this?' Say: It is from your own selves. Surely Allah has power over all things.
3:166: What struck you on the day the two groups met was by Allah's permission, and that He might know the believers.
3:167: And that He might know those who acted hypocritically. When it was said to them: 'Come, fight in the way of Allah or defend,' they said: 'If we knew how to fight, we would follow you.' They were nearer to disbelief on that day than to faith. They say with their mouths what is not in their hearts. Allah knows best what they conceal.
3:168: Those who sat and said of their brothers: 'If they had obeyed us, they would not have been killed.' Say: 'Then avert death from yourselves, if you are truthful.'
3:169: Do not think of those who are killed in the way of Allah as dead; on the contrary, they are alive, being provided for in the presence of their Rabb.
3:170: Rejoicing in what Allah has given them of His bounty, and giving glad tidings to those behind them who have not yet joined them that there is no fear upon them and they will not grieve.
3:171: They are given glad tidings of a blessing and bounty from Allah, and that Allah will not waste the reward of the believers.
3:172: Those who responded to Allah and the Messenger after the wound had struck them. For those among them who did good and guarded (against evil), there is a great reward.
3:173: They are those to whom the people said: 'The people have gathered against you, so fear them,' but it increased their faith, and they said: 'Allah is sufficient for us, and what an excellent Trustee He is.'
3:174: So they returned with a blessing and bounty from Allah, no evil touched them, and they followed the pleasure of Allah, and Allah is the Possessor of great bounty.
3:175: That Satan only frightens his own allies; so do not fear them, but fear Me, if you are believers.
3:176: Do not let those who race in disbelief grieve you; surely they can never harm Allah in anything. Allah intends not to make for them a share in the Hereafter. And for them is a great punishment.
3:177: Surely those who purchase disbelief at the price of faith can never harm Allah in anything, and for them is a painful punishment.
3:178: And let not those who disbelieve think that Our granting them respite is good for themselves; Our granting them respite is only so that they may increase in sin, and for them is a humiliating punishment.
3:179: Allah is not to leave the believers in the state you are in, until He separates the bad from the good. Nor is Allah to inform you of the unseen. But Allah chooses whom He wills of His messengers. So believe in Allah and His messengers. And if you believe and guard (against evil), for you is a great reward.
3:180: Let not those who are stingy with what Allah has given them of His bounty think that it is good for them; on the contrary, it is evil for them. That which they were stingy with will be wrapped around their necks on the Day of Resurrection. And to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. Allah is aware of what you do.
3:181: Certainly Allah has heard the word of those who said, 'Surely Allah is poor and we are rich.' We will write down what they said and their killing of the prophets without right.
3:182: This is because of what your hands have put forward, and surely Allah is not unjust to the servants.
3:183: Those who said: 'Allah made a covenant with us that we should not believe in any messenger until he brings us an offering which fire consumes.' Say: 'Messengers had already come to you before me with clear proofs and with what you said. Why did you kill them, if you are truthful?'
3:184: Then if they deny you, messengers before you were also denied, who came with clear proofs, written pages, and the illuminating Book.
3:185: Every soul will taste death, and your rewards will only be paid in full to you on the Day of Resurrection; and whoever is removed from the Fire and admitted into Paradise, he has indeed succeeded, and the life of this world is nothing but deceptive enjoyment.
3:186: You will surely be tested in your wealth and your lives, and you will surely hear much hurt from those who were given the Book before you and from those who associate partners (with Allah). If you are patient and guard (against evil), surely that is of the matters requiring determination.
3:187: And when Allah took a covenant from those who were given the Book: 'You will surely make it clear to the people and you will not conceal it.' (But) they threw it behind their backs and purchased with it a small price. How evil is that which they purchased!
3:188: Do not think that those who rejoice in what they have done and love to be praised for what they have not done are safe from punishment, and for them is a painful punishment.
3:189: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and Allah has power over all things.
3:190: Undoubtedly, in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the coming of the night and the day one after another, there are many signs for the possessors of intellect.
3:191: They remember Allah while standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and they reflect upon the creation of the heavens and the earth: 'Our Rabb! You did not create this in vain; we declare You free from imperfection, protect us from the punishment of the Fire.'
3:192: Our Rabb! Undoubtedly, whomever You cast into the Fire, You have definitely disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.
3:193: Our Rabb! Undoubtedly, we heard a caller calling to faith saying, 'Believe in your Rabb,' and we believed. Our Rabb! Forgive us our sins, cover our evil deeds, and take our souls along with the good.
3:194: Our Rabb! Grant us what You promised us through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Undoubtedly, You do not break Your promise.
3:195: Their Rabb answered them: 'Undoubtedly, I do not waste the deed of any worker among you, whether male or female. You are from one another. Therefore, those who emigrated, were driven out from their homelands, suffered harm in My way, fought, and were killed (as for them), I will surely cover their evil deeds and I will admit them into gardens beneath which rivers flow; as a reward from Allah's presence. And Allah, with Him is the beautiful reward.'
3:196: Do not let the moving about of those who disbelieve in the cities deceive you.
3:197: A little enjoyment, then their shelter is Hell, and what an evil resting place it is.
3:198: However, for those who fear their Rabb, there are gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, hospitality from Allah's presence; and that which is with Allah is better for the good.
3:199: Undoubtedly, among the People of the Book there are those who believe in Allah, in what has been sent down to you, and in what has been sent down to them, being humble before Allah; they do not sell the verses of Allah for a small price. Those—for them is their reward with their Rabb. Undoubtedly, Allah is swift in reckoning.
3:200: O you who believe! Persevere, outdo in patience, stand on guard, and fear Allah so that you may attain salvation.
